title: Reprint · Dog Night, 2001
logline: The papers run the 2001 Dog Night re-inked in August: the alley, the sign with every letter lit, wordless. The 2010 hand knows the S goes dark in three months and draws it a hair brighter than the rest. The book runs it beside the original and notes the S.

margin.note: A second, smaller date under the gull: 2001.

panels.composition: The alley at night, the sign fully lit, WOOD and BARNABY walking. The S a hair brighter.

image.notes: A reprint: dw_2001-11-15 in the 2010 hand, three months before the S goes dark (dw_2010-11-15).
